callouts: Spotify and WhatsApp are unlimited until curfew
Allowance is based on daily baseline plus lead jobs

allowance.formula: Age x 2.5 per month, rounded to the nearest £5
allowance.schoolTermExtra: During school term: additional allowance for eating at school or college is £35 per month
parentsCover: School shoes if needed for school
Sports kit required for school or clubs

currentOld: Kit old limit: 180 minutes per day
Obie old limit: 90 minutes per day
rules: Spotify and WhatsApp are unlimited until curfew for music and social planning
If you are at a social event, WhatsApp stays available for practical plans, but the phone should stay mostly away
Budget your limited phone time for TikTok, YouTube, games and other non-essential apps
Do not use Spotify or WhatsApp to watch videos or short-form content
No looking at phones in bed, in the morning or in the evening
No TikTok, Shorts or Reels in the first hour after waking
No TikTok, Shorts or Reels in the final hour before bed
Usual phone curfew is age plus 6 hours on a 24-hour clock
Holiday mode means the curfew is one hour later
The same boundaries apply on laptops and TV, so they are not a workaround

rewards.headline: Reading bonus
items: Each child gets £10 for every book plus book report delivered, provided the book is at or above their recommended reading age
The book report can be written, performed as a speech, or made as a video

thresholds: Yellow card: a warning for missed chores or broken rules
Red card: if it keeps happening, allowance and/or screen time is removed

daily.title: Allowance is based on this daily baseline plus the lead jobs below
items: Laundry in basket
Bags and shoes put away
Wrappers and dishes cleared
No bowls or glasses left in bedrooms overnight
Bedroom floor clear
Own mess cleared from shared rooms

dishwasher: Empty dishwasher each morning before lunch
Help make sure dishes are stacked after dinner
Collect stray cups, bowls and plates from shared rooms by evening check
recyclingGarden: Empty indoor recycling into main bins as needed
Do a quick check for indoor and outdoor clutter

items: Deep clean bathroom: £8
Mow lawn: £8
Cut grass borders in garden: £8
Car clean outside: £8
Car clean inside: £8
Weeding or a bigger garden task: £8
Sorting a cupboard or storage area: £8

research.headline: Why the phone rules are tight
stats: Ofcom 2024: 4-15s averaged 8h 29m a week on video-sharing platforms
Ofcom 2024: 12-15s averaged 6h 34m a week of YouTube viewing in the home
NHS-style guidance: keep at least 60 minutes screen-free before sleep
items: Research is more concerned about compulsive, bedtime and short-form use than a single universal screen-time number
NHS-style guidance supports at least 60 minutes screen-free before sleep
